scope: Executable manuscript correspondence; commands are planned benchmark protocols, not evidence of achieved paper scores

experiments.command: python run.py compare --out runs/snbc --method fame_scm_active --reference nn_ei_c --metric rmse --replicates 10000

experiments.question: Equal construction time
